name: Nishiyama Kenji
source:
Ugly and fat, a guy almost 30 years old. He was suddenly fired and now is unemployed.
Hobbies are having sex with prostitutes for satisfying his unequalled sex drive, watching TV and cleaning his room.
Has good muscles but is weak, dislikes fighting and always is on the bullied side as in school, as in society.
For such a good-for-nothing Kenji, can be the encounter with Eriko and her daughters his first big chance?
